name: 0.1.0 alpha 4
title: Settings in tabs, the Wii remote, your own sounds and seventeen themes
highlights: Alpha 3 no longer hangs at a white window on Windows
Settings in eight tabs, with what needs attention first
The Wii remote on a DolphinBar, with its pointer on the shelf
Your own sounds, a sound per console and three new voices

items: Library, Look, Sound, Box art & media, Controls, Shelf, Accounts and System, switched with LB / RB or Page Up / Page Down. Library starts with what needs attention, each with Fix.
A new build shows its highlights once, Settings → System lists every version's notes, and a tour of the shelf runs the first time (Show the tour brings it back).
A new version copies your setup first and puts back a missing or damaged config.json; Undo the update's settings changes puts the copy back. A new RustyShelf folder offers to bring your setup over.
Nintendo and PlayStation pads during a game
Joy-Con, Pro Controller, DualShock 4 and DualSense: their quit combo closes the game and Home opens the Home menu, as an Xbox pad's do.

On a DolphinBar it drives the shelf, Settings and the Home menu, upright or sideways, with a pointer that picks a case. It's handed to Dolphin for a Wii or GameCube game, and Home held opens the Home menu.
With a Twitch developer app's Client ID and Secret (Accounts), Details fills in the description, genres, developer and release LaunchBox is missing.
Disc-era, Handheld and Living room; a sound per console; and Custom sounds from a game, a folder, a file or a ZIP.

Nebula, Abyss, Ember, Dusk, Prism, Hologram, Starfield, Rainy Night, Cherry Blossom, Snowfall, Event Horizon, Glass Lake, Neon City, Deep Sea, Thunderstorm, Fireflies and Desert Night. Pocket, Walnut, CRT and VHS are retired.
Alpha 3 could hang at a white window on Windows as it set its icon.
Its development stopped, so it's out of the native app; View opens Details again. The Electron app keeps its museum.

name: 0.1.0 alpha 1
title: The first alpha of RustyShelf's native app
highlights: The Rust rewrite of the Electron app: one exe for Windows
It shares the Electron app's data folder and file formats, so both can be used on the same library

items: Every console's shelf on the 3D shelf with the Electron app's layout, themes and backgrounds, Home and All shelves, Find a game, Details with game info, favourites, hidden games and collections.
Games with their emulators, the Home menu over a running game, the quit combo and Seamless play.
Downloads (libretro, LaunchBox, GameTDB, the Super Mario Wiki for Switch 2, ScreenScraper and SteamGridDB with your own account and key) and the Art Studio.
archive.org, GamesDatabase, the scan collections and PDFs drawn into pages, with the Manual Studio and the reader.
Steam and the other stores' PC games, RetroAchievements and Steam achievements, the phone companion, sounds and music, data export and the first-run setup.
